summary: Valero Energy Corp filed an 8-K reporting routine items: the planned retirement of Senior Vice President Eric A. Fisher (Item 5.02) and the results of its 2026 annual meeting (Item 5.07), which included director elections and an advisory vote on executive compensation. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is an ordinary current report on standard corporate governance and personnel matters, with no transaction terms, premiums, or structural changes. There is no deal to analyze or risk-arb angle; it is classified as not a special situation.
